trajectory_summary: This is a warm, cooperative lead who volunteers strong qualifying signals (recent tree removal, two EVs including a new Tesla, rising Dominion rates, detailed kWh usage) with almost no resistance. The rep runs the verify section efficiently and books a next-day appointment, but leaves several free anchors unused — the bill was never flipped into urgency, the EV/usage-growth reason was never reinforced, and the wife-on-title disclosure was never resolved into a confirmed co-attendee.

primary_coaching_focus.quote: We're paying about a 150 a month or so to 250.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The customer handed the rep two strong anchors back to back — a $150-250 bill range and an explicit statement that EV-driven usage will keep climbing — and the rep logged both with a flat 'Okay' instead of reflecting either back as the reason to act, leaving the appointment resting on scheduling logistics alone rather than the customer's own stated motivation.
